title: Raspberry Pi CM5-based mini PC targets local OpenClaw deployment

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The Luckfox Lyra PLC is a compact Linux-based programmable logic controller built around the Rockchip RK3506B processor. The DIN-rail system provides dual 100Mbps Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, industrial serial interfaces, CAN, relay outputs, and a 1.9-inch touchscreen. title: Luckfox Lyra PLC Runs Linux on RK3506B with Dual 100Mbps Ethernet

author: Giorgio Mendoza
